title: Natura Beach Bar
image: images/Natura Beach Bar pe nisipul auriu.webp
description: A relaxed beach bar on the western coast of Thassos, with sunbeds, Greek summer flavors, coffee, cocktails and sunset views.

description_i18n.en: A relaxed beach bar on the western coast of Thassos, with sunbeds, Greek summer flavors, coffee, cocktails and sunset views.
description_i18n.ro: Beach bar relaxant pe coasta vestică a insulei Thassos, cu șezlonguri, preparate pentru zile de vară, cafea, cocktailuri și priveliști la apus.
description_i18n.el: Χαλαρό beach bar στη δυτική ακτή της Θάσου, με ξαπλώστρες, καφέ, κοκτέιλ, φαγητό και όμορφα ηλιοβασιλέματα.
description_i18n.de: Entspannte Strandbar an der Westküste von Thassos mit Liegen, Kaffee, Cocktails, kleinen Gerichten und Sonnenuntergangsblick.
description_i18n.bg: Спокоен плажен бар на западния бряг на Тасос с шезлонги, кафе, коктейли, храна и гледки към залеза.
description_i18n.sr: Opušten bar na plaži na zapadnoj obali Tasosa, sa ležaljkama, kafom, koktelima, hranom i pogledom na zalazak sunca.
